sentences.en: And I always tell people, if you're feeling a little bit lost or you're not sure if someone's right for you or you're anxious and you're questioning everything, take time alone to

sentences.zh: 如果你还没听过，一定要去听，它太棒了。

sentences.en: It's super valuable content, especially if you're someone who's going through a hard time in terms of your romantic life.
sentences.zh: 里面的内容非常有价值，特别是如果你正处于感情生活的低谷期。

sentences.en: I couldn't recommend it more highly.
sentences.zh: 我极力推荐。

sentences.en: If you're listening, you really enjoyed this episode.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在听这期节目，并且真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: I know that we both did a lot.
sentences.zh: 我知道我们俩都非常喜欢。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to share it with a friend.
sentences.zh: 也许你想把它分享给某个朋友。

sentences.en: If it's something that a friend needs to hear, please feel free to pass on the love.
sentences.zh: 如果某个朋友正需要听听这些，请尽管把这份爱传递下去。

sentences.en: If you did enjoy this episode, please leave a five-star review on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, wherever you are listening right now.
sentences.zh: 如果你确实喜欢这一期节目，请在 Apple Podcasts、Spotify 或你现在收听节目的任何地方留下五星好评。

sentences.en: It really helps the show to grow and reach new people.
sentences.zh: 这真的能极大地帮助节目成长并接触到更多听众。

sentences.en: And if you want to know more, if you want to be ahead of the news, ahead of the episodes, follow me at That Psychology PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你想了解更多，想走在最新资讯和节目更新的前面，请在社交平台上关注我：@That Psychology Podcast。

sentences.en: I post a lot of updates around what's coming next, merchandise, guests that are coming on.
sentences.zh: 我会发布很多关于后续动态、周边商品以及即将做客嘉宾的更新。

sentences.en: And also, once a month, I let you, the listeners, choose what episode comes out next.
sentences.zh: 而且，每个月我都会让你们——各位听众——来决定下一期播客的主题。

sentences.en: So thank you so much and have a lovely week.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家，祝你们度过愉快的一周。

sentences.en: We'll be back soon with another episode.
sentences.zh: 我们很快就会带着另一期节目回归。

sentences.en: I've been really trying to prioritize my health in a realistic way this year.
sentences.zh: 今年我一直在努力以一种切合实际的方式将健康放在首位。

sentences.en: And something that has kept me really motivated is my WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 而让我保持动力的秘诀就是我的 WHOOP 智能环。

sentences.en: I am such a data person, which is why I love WHOOP, because I can genuinely see why my body
sentences.zh: 我是一个超级注重数据的人，这也是我热爱 WHOOP 的原因，因为我可以清楚地看到，为什么我的身体

sentences.en: feels differently depending on the day, why I'm running differently, why I'm maybe less focused.
sentences.zh: 会随着每天的不同而有不同的感受，为什么我跑步的状态不一样，为什么我有时注意力不那么集中。

sentences.en: WHOOP effortlessly tracks my sleep.
sentences.zh: WHOOP 能够轻松追踪我的睡眠。

sentences.en: It tracks my strain, my recovery, my stress.
sentences.zh: 它能追踪我的身体负荷、恢复情况和压力水平。

sentences.en: And most importantly, my overall health.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，它能追踪我的整体健康状况。

sentences.en: And it just gives me all that data and all those patterns so I can make better decisions, which includes knowing when to go easy and knowing when to go hard.
sentences.zh: 它为我提供了所有的这些数据和规律，让我能够做出更好的决策，这包括知道什么时候该放松，什么时候该加把劲。

sentences.en: New members can try WHOOP with a 30-day free trial before committing to a membership.
sentences.zh: 新成员可以在正式订购会员前，通过 30 天免费试用来体验 WHOOP。

sentences.en: That's join.whoop.com slash psychology for your free month of WHOOP.
sentences.zh: 访问 join.whoop.com/psychology 即可免费体验一个月的 WHOOP。
